title: Spyre-Accelerated Retrieval-Augmented Generation on IBM LinuxONE: A Cloud-Native Architecture for Secure, High-Throughput Enterprise AI Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.21393v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Running large language models inside enterprise environments has always bumped up against a practical wall: the data lives in one place, the AI horsepower sits somewhere else, and moving sensitive records between the two creates real headaches around latency, security, and regulatory exposure. IBM's Spyre accelerator PCIe inference card built for LinuxONE and the broader IBM Z family changes that equation.   In this paper we lay out a six-subsystem RAG architecture that runs entirely on IBM LinuxONE, using Spyre for generative inference, the Telum II on-chip accelerator for lightweight classification tasks, and Red Hat OpenShift for container orchestration. Every piece of the pipeline from query intake through vector retrieval, prompt assembly, LLM inference, compliance filtering, and response delivery stays within a single LinuxONE system, so sensitive data never has to leave the hardware perimeter.   We walk through the design choices

translated_title: Spyre加速的IBM LinuxONE检索增强生成：一种用于安全、高吞吐企业AI推理的云原生架构
translated_abstract: 摘要：在企业环境中运行大型语言模型一直面临实际障碍：数据存储在一处，AI计算能力位于另一处，而在这两者之间移动敏感记录会引发延迟、安全性和监管风险方面的严重问题。IBM专为LinuxONE和更广泛的IBM Z系列设计的Spyre加速器PCIe推理卡改变了这一局面。本文提出了一种完全运行在IBM LinuxONE上的六子系统RAG架构，利用Spyre进行生成式推理，Telum II片上加速器处理轻量级分类任务，Red Hat OpenShift负责容器编排。从查询输入、向量检索、提示组装、LLM推理、合规过滤到响应交付的整个流水线，都保持在单一LinuxONE系统内，因此敏感数据无需离开硬件边界。我们详细阐述了设计选择。
tldr: 本文提出了一种完全基于IBM LinuxONE的六子系统RAG架构，利用Spyre加速器和Telum II芯片，在单一硬件边界内实现安全、高吞吐的企业级AI推理，消除数据迁移风险。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a six-subsystem RAG architecture entirely on IBM LinuxONE, leveraging Spyre accelerators and Telum II chips to achieve secure, high-throughput enterprise AI inference within a single hardware perimeter, eliminating data migration risks.
